assets.note: 24 workstations, 193 host->destination channels, 24 h, fixed seeds so every student sees the same numbers. Intervals are real agent defaults (EDR 300 s, monitoring 60 s, backup 1 h, update 6 h, licence 12 h) rather than numbers chosen to make a point. THE SHAPE IS REAL AND THE CONSTANTS ARE THIS GENERATOR'S - LAB.md and estate.py both say so, because a student who quotes '144 false positives' as a fact about networks has learned the wrong thing.

assets.name: lab-15 source files
assets.note: estate.py, inbox.py, collector.py, detect.py, limit.py, evade.py, variants.py, evidence.py, check.py, runner.py, lab15lib.py, entrypoint.sh, LAB.md, detector.json (x2), variants.json, record.txt, assets.json. The only bytes this lab adds.

new_bytes_for_this_lab: source files only - no model, no apt package, no pip package

ports.8015: Mock collector, 127.0.0.1 ONLY, inside the container. Started and stopped by inbox.py, limit.py and evade.py as a child process. NEVER published with -p: a loopback bind inside a container cannot be reached from the host (measured at lab 12), so -p would promise a browser view that does not work, and there is nothing to view. The port exists because a rate limiter that is not in a request path is not a rate limiter - the prevent stub's measured cost would otherwise be fiction.

runtime.network: none - the container runs with --network none and the lab says so on screen. This lab is about detecting traffic leaving a network, so it is given no network to leave.
runtime.peak_rss: to be measured at --cpus=2 --memory=2g with ru_maxrss. Expected ~1.41 GB, matching labs 12-14, and driven entirely by the single model load in variants.py. NOTE: the cgroup memory.peak for the same run reads about 5x lower because llama.cpp mmaps the GGUF; quote ru_maxrss, which is what a student sees in Activity Monitor or Task Manager.
runtime.note: ONE GENERATION, ONE PROCESS - and it is the only model call in the lab. Everything else (the estate, the four limbs, the sweep, the cap, the split payload, the window tune, the evidence) is deterministic Python with fixed seeds and runs in milliseconds. That asymmetry is the lab's thesis: the only nondeterministic thing here is the ATTACKER'S SURFACE, and the detector does not read surface. Assertions key on the field count and the verdict record, never on the model's prose.

deliberately_fails.what: The operator slows to a 4 h interval, jitters 90%, and splits the record 2 values per check-in. Three of the four limbs go dark, the score falls to 2 against a threshold of 4, and the detector MISSES it.
deliberately_fails.why_kept: Without the miss there is nothing to recover from and step 9 has no lesson. It also carries the lab's sharpest negative result: the student has already measured (step 5) that lowering the threshold to catch it costs 72 false positives, so the dial is visibly not the fix. The recovery is the matching WINDOW - reassemble the channel's day, then match - which catches it at zero false-positive cost. runner.py FAILS THE LAB if this beat is ever CAUGHT before the tune, because that would mean the estate or the limbs have drifted and the recovery beat is teaching nothing.

measured_premise.signature_rule_on_the_variants: 8/10 - base64 and hex get past, and needed no AI
measured_premise.content_limb_on_the_variants: 10/10, with 0/6 clean and random-noise controls tripped
measured_premise.lab7_dial_swept_to_catch_slow: must reach 4 check-ins/day; precision peaks at 0.0127 and then falls
measured_premise.four_limb_score_at_threshold_4: 1 TP / 0 FP, precision 1.0000, and it holds at 95% jitter
measured_premise.lab7s_own_clean_setting: 2 h / 95% jitter scores 4 and is FLAGGED - the setting the student escaped with as the attacker in lab 7 is caught by the detector they build here
measured_premise.the_miss: 4 h / 90% / split 2-of-6 scores 2 and is MISSED
measured_premise.the_recovery: per-channel-day matching turns 2/6 into 6/6, score 4, CAUGHT, at 0 extra false positives
measured_premise.rate_cap_at_6_per_hour: throttles 1296/1440 beacon check-ins, touches 0 of the evasive channel's 5, costs 120 of 192 legitimate channels their traffic, and all 6 record values reach the collector anyway
measured_premise.cost_of_evasion: 864x slower - 500 records from 0.35 days to 300 days
